category: premium file host (one-click hoster), retrieval target

free_tier.stated: Free tier is measured, not published: 125-130 KB/s in Chrome in the July 2026 test, which the tester called the slowest usable free tier in the set.

per_object_cap.stated: 'Unlimited File Size' is a VIP-only benefit; the base premium column does not list it

retention.stated: not published on the premium page

egress.terms: Traffic is sold in 5-day windows, not per day: 60 GB or 300 GB 'of traffic in any 5 days'. Speed is 'Unlimited Speed' on both paid tiers.
egress.free_allowance: 60 GB / 5 days on Premium (12 GB/day, 0.33 TiB/30d); 300 GB / 5 days on VIP (60 GB/day, 1.64 TiB/30d)
egress.price_per_tb: no overage price; the only lever is VIP

interface_detail: No API page found. The K2S-family sites publish a separate API, but FileJoker's own premium page does not reference one.
tooling: JDownloader 2 (12.62 MB/s combined in the July 2026 test); iOS and Android apps
chaining: Only worth a key when the archive is FileJoker-hosted; VIP is the tier that reaches one TiB a month, at roughly four times 1fichier's rate.

limits.value: 60 GB per 5 days on Premium, 300 GB per 5 days on VIP
free tier measured at 125-130 KB/s = 0.119-0.124 MiB/s

limits_note: The 5-day window is not a daily counter; an unused part of a window cannot be carried into the next.
binding_note: The base premium plan clears only a third of 1 TiB a month, so the choice is VIP or nothing, and VIP's counter is what decides the month.

identity_cost.detail: E-mail signup; card and crypto payment.

reliability_note: Free downloads are 0.12 MiB/s, which is a 102-day transfer for one TiB; the paid tiers are the only usable path.
confidence_note: Price, tier structure and the 5-day traffic windows are from the vendor premium page read today. The free-tier speed is third-party.

evidence.proved: Premium $22.95/mo '60.000 MB of traffic in any 5 days'; Premium VIP $33.95/mo '300.000 MB of traffic in any 5 days'; 'Unlimited File Size' listed under VIP
JD2 12.62 MB/s combined, browser 11.8 MB/s, free 125-130 KB/s

price_per_tb_month: USD 20.74 per TiB-month on VIP (USD 33.95 for 1.64 TiB of allowance); USD 22.95 buys only 0.33 TiB on the base plan
notes: The 5-day window is the unusual part: a client that pulls 200 GB in one weekend and nothing for three weeks is inside VIP's allowance, while a steady 40 GB/day is not.

extras.price_ladder_reported: Premium USD 22.95 / month with 60 GB of traffic in any 5 days; Premium VIP USD 33.95 / month with 300 GB in any 5 days
